_meta.description: Khabo Kothay Discovery Facts — FINAL APPROVED DATASET after data-ownership audit. Ready for Supabase import (migration PROPOSED_1_3_discovery_facts.sql must be applied first).
_meta.rules: status=APPROVED facts carry source_reference AND evidence_note (v1.3 CHECK constraint). No AI-generated text. (restaurant_id, fact_text) unique per row.

facts.fact_text: Adana Sofrasi opened in December 2025 on the second floor of FC Enclave on Gulshan Avenue, making it one of Dhaka's newer Turkish restaurants.
facts.evidence_note: "When Adana Sofrasi launched in December last year, it promised diners authentic Turkish flavours paired with an interior inspired by the soul of Turkey."

facts.fact_text: Adana Sofrasi hosts 'Suqoon-e-Sofra', a recurring ticketed evening of live Sufi music (about BDT 990 per person, reservation only, food excluded).
facts.evidence_note: "Following the beautiful response to our first Suqoon-e-Sofra, we're bringing the experience back for another evening of soulful melodies... Ticket: BDT 990 per person... Reservation Only."

facts.fact_text: Ajo Idea Space takes its name from the Bangla word 'ajo' ('new'), and its Gulshan branch was built almost entirely from reclaimed materials, including a repurposed swimming pool roughly 60 years old.
facts.evidence_note: "Ajo Idea Space is named after the Bangla word 'Ajo' which translates to 'new'... crafted almost entirely from reclaimed materials, including the repurposing of a swimming pool that is almost 60 years old."

facts.fact_text: Ajo Idea Space sources roughly 2-3% of its food ingredients from abroad, with the rest sourced locally.
facts.evidence_note: "Ajo Idea Space sources a mere 2% to 3% of its food ingredients from abroad, the rest are sourced locally."

facts.fact_text: The Gulshan branch of Ajo Idea Space won the Berger Best Interior Design Award 2025 in the Professional category.
facts.evidence_note: "This June, the space achieved a major milestone by winning the Berger Best Interior Design Award 2025 in the Professional category."

facts.fact_text: Al-Amar began serving Lebanese cuisine in Dhanmondi in December 2015 and later added its Gulshan 2 outlet on Level 12 of Rangs FC Square.
facts.source_reference: The Daily Star (2016) & The Business Standard (2020) - https://www.thedailystar.net/shout/food/medley-meat-and-spices-1205203 ; https://www.tbsnews.net/feature/food/al-amar-best-lebanese-cuisine-town-119296
facts.evidence_note: Daily Star: "this place has been adding a new level of variety since December 2015." TBS (2020): "Al-Amar has been serving authentic Lebanese dishes for almost five years... A new outlet in Gulshan 2 will be opened soon."

facts.fact_text: Alfresco opened in October 2014 as an initiative of three friends and grew from a single outlet into a small chain across Dhaka.
facts.evidence_note: "An initiative by three close friends, Kazi Md Rushdi, Mahathir Mohammad Ayan, and Md Mahmudul Hasan, Alfresco opened its doors to food lovers of the capital back in October 2014."

facts.restaurant_name: Almajlis Arabian Restaurant | مطعم المجلس العربي
facts.fact_text: Almajlis keeps a compact menu built around chicken dishes and freshly baked Yemeni molawah flatbread, with lamb mandi as a flagship item.
facts.evidence_note: Official blog: mandi is "widely regarded as the national dish of Yemen"; foodpanda lists "Molawah - Traditional Yemeni flatbread, freshly baked"; menu listing is short and mostly chicken items.

facts.restaurant_name: Amaya Food Gallery at Amari Dhaka
facts.fact_text: Amaya is designed as an indoor 'hawker stall' restaurant with live cooking stations, mixing international and Asian dishes.
facts.source_reference: Amari Dhaka official site & The Business Standard (2025) - https://www.amari.com/dhaka/dine/amaya ; https://www.tbsnews.net/economy/corporates/amari-dhaka-launches-flavour-show-amaya-food-gallery-1206681
facts.evidence_note: Official site: "a vibrant, indoor hawker stall paradise with live cooking stations serving up international cuisine and Asian favourites inspired by local flavours." TBS describes the 'Flavour Show' live-station format.

facts.fact_text: American Burger is one of the older local burger chains in Dhaka, operating before the gourmet-burger wave (Takeout, Madchef) of the 2010s.
facts.evidence_note: "Once upon a time... Then came along American Burger, elevating the whole burger business. And in the 2010s, several burger joints such as Takeout and Madchef opened up."

facts.fact_text: American Burger is one of the older local burger chains in Dhaka, operating before the gourmet-burger wave (Takeout, Madchef) of the 2010s.
facts.evidence_note: "Then came along American Burger, elevating the whole burger business. And in the 2010s, several burger joints such as Takeout and Madchef opened up."

facts.fact_text: Amrit, the Indian restaurant at Hotel Sarina in Banani, opened in 2007.
facts.evidence_note: Prothom Alo references "Amrit's remarkable journey since its inception in 2007"; Daily Star addresses the restaurant as "Restaurant Amrit, Hotel Sarina, House #27, Banani C/A, Road#17."

facts.fact_text: Amrit's menu is built around Mughal-influenced cooking, with an emphasis on 'dumpakht' dishes developed around Awadhi and Hyderabadi specialisations.
facts.evidence_note: "Restaurant Amrit has launched its new menu that is a representation of Mughal influences... with an emphasis on the famed 'dumpakht'... based on Mohammad Rais's specialisations in Awadhi and Hyderabadi cuisine."

facts.fact_text: Amrit's signature Bahubali Thali requires about five hours' advance notice.
facts.evidence_note: "The signature Bahubali Thali needs at least 5 hours preorder."

facts.restaurant_name: Ankur Healing Restaurant, Gulshan Lake Drive
facts.fact_text: Ankur is run by farmers and serves 'healing' Bengali meals made without oil, using produce grown without pesticides or chemical fertilizers; it also sells fresh vegetables.
facts.source_reference: LinkedIn posts by Ankur staff and associates (2025) - https://www.linkedin.com/posts/shafiqrbhuiyan_i-wanted-to-share-a-truly-wonderful-experience-activity-7291006449688715264-5j2L ; https://www.linkedin.com/posts/helal-hedaitul-islam-19329819_ankur-restaurant-run-by-the-farmers-all-activity-7325008194005520384-MRTK
facts.evidence_note: "A healthy and sustainable food restaurant called Ankur Restaurant, nestled by the serene Gulshan Lake... dedicated to serving completely oil-free, green food sourced directly from farmers in various regions. They even sell fresh green vegetables."; "run by the farmers, all foods are naturally grown (without pesticide & chemical fertilizer)."

facts.fact_text: Baan Busaba opened in early August 2025 at Hamid Tower, Gulshan Circle 2.
facts.evidence_note: "Opened in early August 2025, Baan Busaba's biggest change is to maintain authenticity for three different cuisines."

facts.fact_text: Baan Busaba presents itself as East-Asian rather than fusion, with dedicated chefs for its Thai, Korean and Chinese sections.
facts.evidence_note: Managing Director Saadman Hossain: "It's not a fusion, it's not Pan-Asian. It is East-Asian, and we have specialized chefs for each of our Thai, Korean, and Chinese sections."

facts.fact_text: Baan Busaba is a sibling venture to the Thai restaurant Ruen Busaba, run by the same founder, Saadman Hossain.
facts.evidence_note: TBS on Ruen Busaba founder Saadman Hossain: "Saadman plans to launch another Thai-based fast-food chain named Baan Busaba."

facts.fact_text: Bahar is the all-day international restaurant of Renaissance Dhaka Gulshan Hotel (Level 3) and has three private dining areas.
facts.source_reference: Marriott (Renaissance Dhaka Gulshan official dining page) - https://www.marriott.com/en-us/hotels/dacbr-renaissance-dhaka-gulshan-hotel/dining/
facts.evidence_note: "Bahar... super stylish all-day international hotel restaurant... Three private dining areas are also available." (Level 3 confirmed by The Current View / ICE Business Times.)

facts.fact_text: Bahar regularly runs themed buffet nights - recent examples include a Turkish theme ('A Taste of Turkey') and an Italian theme ('Buon Appetito').
facts.source_reference: The Current View (2026) & Bangladesh Monitor (2026) - https://thecurrentview.com/?p=5968 ; https://bangladeshmonitor.com.bd/en/renaissance-dhaka-gulshan-introduces-italian-themed-weekend-dining
facts.evidence_note: "Bahar Restaurant... officially unveils 'A Taste of Turkey'... launching on April 30, 2026"; "launched 'Buon Appetito,' an Italian-themed weekend dining experience at its signature all-day dining restaurant, Bahar."

facts.fact_text: Bamboo Shoot has operated in the same RM Centre building on Gulshan Avenue since at least 2009 and is Chinese-owned, with a largely Chinese-expat clientele.
facts.source_reference: Feinfood.com (Chinese listing), Japanese expat blog (2009) & M's Adventures (2012) - http://cn.feinfood.com/restaurant/... ; http://bangladeshtourism.cocolog-nifty.com/blog/2009/06/banboo-shoot-ee.html ; https://madventures.me/2012/03/13/dhaka-restaurants-part-one/
facts.evidence_note: Feinfood: "known veteran Chinese restaurant in Dhaka, preferred gathering place for local Chinese expats"; 2009 blogger: "the customers are mostly Chinese"; 2012: "Chinese owned Chinese food."

facts.fact_text: The kitchen covers Cantonese and Sichuan dishes, including hotpot, and an authentic Chinese menu runs alongside its regular Bangladeshi-Chinese menu.
facts.evidence_note: M's Adventures: "This place also serves Sichuan hotpot... have them insist on seeing the Chinese menu"; Feinfood: "菜肴有粤菜和川菜，还有火锅" (Cantonese and Sichuan dishes, plus hotpot).

facts.fact_text: Bar.B.Q Tonight is the Dhaka franchise of the Pakistani restaurant brand of the same name (founded in Karachi in 1988); its Gulshan restaurant opened in 2017.
facts.source_reference: Dhaka Tribune (2025) & Bar.B.Q Tonight official site - https://www.dhakatribune.com/feature/food/387948/bar-b-q-tonight-serving-delectable-pakistani ; https://www.barbq-tonight.com/
facts.evidence_note: Dhaka Tribune: "Opened in 2017... we are a franchise"; official site: "Inaugurated on the 10th of November in 1988... started serving authentic Pakistani dishes."

facts.fact_text: Bar.B.Q Tonight in Gulshan is a franchise distinct from the similarly named Bangladeshi brand 'Bar B Q Tonite' in Dhanmondi.
facts.evidence_note: Manager Saiful Islam Palash: "often confused with Bar B Q Tonite in Dhanmondi... they are a franchise, while the one in Dhanmondi is a Bangladeshi brand and the two are completely different."

facts.fact_text: Barcode Cafe is an outpost of the Barcode Restaurant Group, a Chittagong-based company that began as a coffee shop named 'Barcode' in 2015.
facts.evidence_note: Dhaka Tribune: "opened a coffee shop named Barcode... in 2015"; Daily Star: Barcode Cafe is among the "brainchildren of successful businessman Monjurul Hoque... He also owns another branch of Barcode at Banani in Dhaka."

facts.fact_text: Beyond Buffet's Gulshan branch offers more than 100 items at lunch and over 120 at dinner.
facts.evidence_note: "The Gulshan branch offers more than 100 items for lunch and over 120 items for dinner."

facts.fact_text: Beyond Buffet also operates as a banquet venue; its Gulshan branch advertises a guest capacity of about 450.
facts.evidence_note: Company posts: "Book your next AGM, team lunch, or seminar at Beyond Buffet, Gulshan... with the best with 100+ Buffet items"; Bengali post states Gulshan guest capacity of 450+.

facts.fact_text: BFC (Best Fried Chicken) launched in 2002 under the Opex & Sinha Group and is among the earlier homegrown fried-chicken chains in Bangladesh.
facts.source_reference: BFC official site & The Business Standard (2025) - https://www.bfcbd.com/ ; https://www.tbsnews.net/features/food/clash-crispy-can-chicken-buzz-dethrone-best-fried-chicken-1073616
facts.evidence_note: Official site: "Best Fried Chicken (BFC) started its journey back in 2002... under the guidance of Anisur Rahman Sinha"; TBS: "Starting their journey in 2002, BFC has been around for more than two decades."

facts.fact_text: BFC sources its chicken from its own poultry farm in Rangpur.
facts.evidence_note: Wikimapia: "the juicy fresh Chicken is formed by the owners at their expanding farm facility in Rangpur"; reviewer: "Thanks to the parent company having backward integration having own poultry."

facts.fact_text: Bistro-E sits inside Bay's Edgewater on North Avenue, Gulshan 2, a building that also houses embassy offices, so diners pass through security screening before entering.
facts.source_reference: Bistro-E official site & Wanderlog review - https://bistro-e.com/ ; https://wanderlog.com/place/details/2847385/bistro-e
facts.evidence_note: Official site: "nestled in Bay's Edgewater on North Avenue, Gulshan 2"; reviewer: "you've to go through some security checks because many embassy offices are located in the building."

facts.fact_text: Bluemoon Recreation Club opened in 2012.
facts.evidence_note: "Bluemoon Re-Creation Club Opened in the year 2012."

facts.fact_text: Combines a restaurant, bar, gym and billiards tables in one venue, with live music on certain days.
facts.evidence_note: Wanderlog: "a restaurant serving international cuisines, as well as a gym and billiard area" alongside the bar.

facts.fact_text: Features an American-style neon-lit bar atmosphere with live music on certain days.
facts.evidence_note: Wanderlog: "a unique American bar experience with neon lighting and live music on certain days."

facts.fact_text: The bar area is adults-only; children and teens are not admitted.
facts.evidence_note: TripAdvisor (2017): "only for adults kids and teens are not allowed."

facts.fact_text: BOHO holds the Thai SELECT certificate awarded by the Royal Thai Government's Ministry of Commerce for authentic Thai cuisine; the certificate was handed over at BOHO Bond Centre in Banani in August 2025.
facts.source_reference: The Business Standard, Prothom Alo & New Age (2025) - https://www.tbsnews.net/economy/corporates/boho-awarded-thai-select-certificate-authentic-thai-cuisine-1203521 ; https://en.prothomalo.com/corporate/vmcl9yj7e3 ; https://www.newagebd.net/post/mis/272001/boho-gets-thai-select-certificate
facts.evidence_note: TBS: "The Thai SELECT certification is awarded by the Ministry of Commerce, Royal Thai Government, to recognise restaurants and food products that preserve the authenticity of Thai cuisine."

facts.fact_text: BOHO's interior was handcrafted by local artisans and designed by GOAAT, the same architectural practice behind Ajo Idea Space.
facts.source_reference: Archinect / LinkedIn (interior designer Nehleen Chowdhury, GOAAT) - https://archinect.com/nchowdhury/project/boho-banani
facts.evidence_note: "An attempt at handcrafting an interior with local resources, local artisans and craftsmen's..." by the "Group of Architects and Thinkers (GOAAT)."

facts.fact_text: Boithok also operates as an events venue: in 2025 it hosted a sustainable water-grid technology fair and a Cannes Lions creative masterclass in Banani.
facts.evidence_note: Tech fair 'taking place on Monday, September 29, 2025, at Boithok, Banani, Dhaka'; masterclass 'Join AAAB on 23 August 2025, 11 AM - 6 PM at Boithok, Banani, Dhaka'.

facts.fact_text: Named for the Bengali word 'boithok' (a gathering place); the interior is styled as a vintage Bengali meeting house with a book collection.
facts.evidence_note: Wanderlog: "beautiful interior featuring Bengali aesthetics and a unique collection of books."

facts.fact_text: Boomers Cafe's first outlet opened in Banani, where it began as an adda (hangout) spot mostly for NSU and AIUB students.
facts.source_reference: The Daily Star, Star Campus archive (2011) — https://archive.thedailystar.net/campus/2011/12/01/edibles.htm
facts.evidence_note: 'The first Boomers café opened up in Banani, for which it was an adda house mostly for North South University (NSU) and American International University of Bangladesh (AIUB) students.'

facts.fact_text: Boomers Cafe is credited with helping popularize pool/billiards as a student activity in Dhaka when it first opened.
facts.source_reference: The Daily Star, Star Campus archive (2011) — https://archive.thedailystar.net/campus/2011/12/01/edibles.htm
facts.evidence_note: The Daily Star (2011): "When Boomers Café opened up, it instantly gained popularity as a student lounge, where the pool culture kicked off in Dhaka."

facts.fact_text: Brio's Gulshan dining room has no signboard; the entrance is marked only by a small illuminated Italian flag, a deliberate choice by the owners.
facts.evidence_note: 'it doesn't even have a signboard outside, just a small Italian flag that lights up. The owners prefer it that way, confident that word of mouth is the way to go.'

facts.fact_text: The Gulshan-2 location is Brio's flagship dining room, where pizza is wood-fired and pasta is hand-rolled.
facts.evidence_note: 'Our flagship dining room in the heart of Gulshan‑2 — wood-fired pizza, hand-rolled pasta and the full Italian table.'

facts.fact_text: The interiors of Bukhara were designed by Bangladeshi architect Enamul Karim Nirjhar (System Architects), one of a series of conceptual restaurants he created in Dhaka.
facts.source_reference: Wikipedia — Enamul Karim Nirjhar (2026) — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enamul_Karim_Nirjhar ; Shaping Bangladesh — https://shapingbangladesh.com/archive/issues/20th-issue/shaped-by-freedom-the-creative-world-of-ar-enamul-karim-nirjhar
facts.evidence_note: 'He designed several conceptual restaurants in Dhaka and Chittagong, including Bukhara, Santoor, Bonanza, White Castle, and Asparagus.'

facts.fact_text: Bukhara sits on the 17th floor of Iqbal Center at 42 Kemal Ataturk Avenue in Banani, putting the dining room high above the avenue.
facts.source_reference: Google Maps listing (batch data, 17th floor); staff profile on LinkedIn (2026) — https://linkedin.com/in/md-abdul-kader-1b8310100
facts.evidence_note: Staff record: 'Captain - Bukhara Restaurant, Aug 1999 - Aug 2007, Banani 42, Iqbal Center 18th Floor' (older record; current listing says 17th floor).

facts.fact_text: Bunka runs an All-You-Can-Order (AYCO) format: diners pick dishes from a menu and the kitchen cooks them fresh, rather than serving from a buffet line.
facts.evidence_note: 'It's a buffet—but not the usual kind! Bunka offers an All You Can Order (AYCO)/ Service buffet, where you choose your dishes from the menu, and the chef cooks them freshly and live.'

facts.fact_text: Bunka rotates a new themed menu roughly every two months; past themes include Thai Odyssey, Tokyo Treats, Dragon Fire Feast, Gangnam Bites and Indo Malay Flavour.
facts.evidence_note: 'Every two months, Bunka unveils a new culinary chapter with themed menus such as Thai Odyssey, Tokyo Treats, Dragon Fire Feast, Gangnam Bites, and Indo Malay Flavour.'

facts.fact_text: Bunka occupies the 13th floor of Six Seasons Hotel, with long glass windows overlooking Gulshan Lake.
facts.source_reference: Six Seasons Hotel official site; The Daily Star (2014) — https://www.thedailystar.net/luxury-redefined-45314
facts.evidence_note: 'the long glass windows mirror the beautiful, serene Gulshan lake'; 'Climb 13 floors and you will be greeted by the spectacular sight of the third restaurant - Bunka.'

facts.fact_text: Burgwich Town is part of the Chattogram-based Barcode Restaurant Group, which began as a single coffee shop in 2012 and has since expanded to restaurants across Chattogram, Dhaka and the UAE.
facts.evidence_note: 'Monjurul Hoque, a young entrepreneur, started a restaurant business in 2012 with a coffee shop and has since expanded to 22 restaurants in Chattogram, Dhaka, and the UAE.'

facts.fact_text: The Banani outlet operates as 'Burgwich Town Fusion Cafe', combining burgers with fuchka and chaat items on its delivery menu.
facts.evidence_note: Listing shows 'Burgwich Town Fusion Cafe - Banani' with a 'Fuchka & Chaat' section alongside its burger menu.

facts.fact_text: The Gulshan outlet was C House Milano's first store in Asia; the Italian company behind the brand announced its opening on 11 March 2021.
facts.source_reference: Cristiano Iezzi, owner of C House Italia Srl (LinkedIn, 2021) — https://www.linkedin.com/posts/cristiano-iezzi-79b5b66_harder-better-faster-stronger-c-house-activity-6777199882273861632--Mzi ; Dhaka Tribune (2023) — https://www.dhakatribune.com/feature/food/325324/c-house-milano-takes-an-elegant-approach-to
facts.evidence_note: 'C House Milano Cafè | Restaurant and La Pizzeria Nazionale in Dhaka - Bangladesh! Unlocked from 11th of March 2021! Our first store in Asia!' (owner post).

facts.fact_text: Cafe CAF prints personalized images onto coffee: a customer can send a photo and it appears on the latte foam in edible ink.
facts.evidence_note: 'the shop offers personalised coffee art ... once my cup of coffee arrived ... The cream was topped with a clear image of the dog, done in edible ink.'

facts.fact_text: Cafe CAF is built around all-day breakfasts and coffee, open from 8am to midnight.
facts.evidence_note: Headline: 'Cafe CAF: Of fresh brews and all-day breakfasts'; 'The shop opens at 8 AM in the morning and closes at midnight.'

facts.fact_text: Cafe Mango was founded by architect Salauddin Ahmed; the first Mango opened in Dhanmondi on 9 November 2000 and the Gulshan branch followed in October 2004.
facts.source_reference: The Daily Star, Star Weekend Magazine (2004) — https://archive.thedailystar.net/magazine/2004/12/04/eating.htm
facts.evidence_note: 'The Mango in Dhanmondi was started in November 9, 2000'; 'the second Mango was born on October 1, 2004.'

facts.fact_text: Cafe Mango's interior is built around Bangladeshi rural heritage: old bed headrests line the ceiling and wooden windows from village tin-shed houses are set into the walls.
facts.evidence_note: 'Looking up at the ceiling of the restaurant, you will be able to see the headrest of old beds. On the first floor ... the wooden windows of tin-shed houses from the rural part of Bangladesh.'

facts.fact_text: The owner's stated aim was to make Cafe Mango a 'public living room' where people stay for hours rather than just dine.
facts.evidence_note: 'I wanted it to be something where people would come and stay for hours' (Salauddin Ahmed); 'an attempt to bring forth public living rooms in Dhaka.'

facts.fact_text: Cha Bagan ('tea garden' in Bengali) operates as a rooftop garden cafe in Banani, with a greenery-filled, nature-themed space.
facts.evidence_note: 'Cha Bagan is an enchanting outdoor dining spot ... Nestled on a rooftop in Banani, this venue features a breathtaking garden.'

facts.fact_text: Chef's Table is operated by Unimart, a sister concern of United Group, and the brand's outlet opened in Gulshan in July 2018.
facts.evidence_note: 'Chef's Table is the latest initiative by Unimart, a sister concern of United Group ... had its soft launch on July 1 last year and was opened for all since July 12.'

facts.fact_text: Chef's Table Gulshan 1 works as a food court whose resident brands include Chillox, Yum Cha District and Cheez, with ordering through a digital system.
facts.evidence_note: 'Savor delicious food from well-known outlets like Chillox, Yum Cha District, The Bunka, Cheez, and more'; 'fast and organized service through a digital ordering system.'

facts.fact_text: Chef's Table Gulshan 2 is the brand's original outlet: it opened in July 2018 by Unimart with 24 food stalls serving about 22 cuisine types in a 27,000 sq ft space.
facts.evidence_note: 'currently serving 22 types of cuisine'; 'Developed in a 27,000 square feet area, Chef's Table consists of 24 food stalls.'

facts.fact_text: The company behind Chef's Table says customers often describe it as the first proper multi-brand food court in Bangladesh.
facts.evidence_note: BBF Digital (2020) CEO interview: "many consider us to be the first-ever proper food court in Bangladesh."

facts.fact_text: Cheong Shing is cited in Dhaka food writing as one of the city's authentic Chinese restaurants - Cantonese-style food rather than the local 'deshi' Chinese style.
facts.source_reference: The Daily Star (2023) — https://online.thedailystar.net/my-dhaka/news/authentic-isnt-everything-nothing-hits-the-spot-deshi-chinese-food-3416631 ; The Business Standard (2020) — https://www.tbsnews.net/feature/food/when-chinese-food-not-chinese-122323
facts.evidence_note: 'Dhaka also boasts many authentic Chinese dining places, serving Cantonese, Hunan, Sichuan cuisines. Places like Cheong Shing, Yum Cha District, Chows'; TBS: 'the Cheong Shing restaurant in Banani probably sells some authentic Chinese dishes.'

facts.fact_text: Cheong Shing has been operating in Banani since at least the early 2010s.
facts.source_reference: Dhaka Delicacy food blog (2010) — http://dhakadelicacy.blogspot.com/2010/02/ ; Faizul Khan blog (2011) — https://faizulkhan.blogspot.com/2011/06/chinese-at-cheong-shing.html
facts.evidence_note: 'I love this place in Banani- Chong SHing, been going there for years' (2010); 'Cheong Shing ... finds authentic Chinese in Banani' (2011).

facts.fact_text: Chilis is a Chinese/Thai restaurant in Banani (not the US chain) that shares its venue with Santoor, an Indian dining brand - both cuisines can be ordered from the same location.
facts.source_reference: Pathao Food — https://food.pathao.com/restaurants/ge4dkni/chilis ; Chilis BD Facebook (2026) — https://www.facebook.com/ChilisBD/posts/1235936222037557/ ; Santoor & Chilis Instagram (2026)
facts.evidence_note: Pathao lists 'Chilis - Banani ... Chinese, Thai'; Chilis BD: 'You can order food from both Santoor and Chillis at the same location'; Instagram: '@santoorfusiondining & @chilis.bd now under one Roof.'

facts.fact_text: Chillox began in February 2016 as a roadside burger cart opposite BRAC University in Mohakhali; its first permanent outlet opened in Mohakhali in 2017.
facts.evidence_note: 'The food cart that started its journey in February 2016 had to shut down for placement reasons in the December of the same year ... in 2017 ... Chillox launched its first proper outlet at Mohakhali.'

facts.fact_text: Chillox lets customers pick a sauce level for their burgers, a signature of the chain.
facts.evidence_note: 'What is your preferred sauce level, sir?'; 'They brought the flexibility of choosing sauce levels to cater to customers' demands.'

facts.fact_text: Chows positions itself as a fine-dining Cantonese and dim sum restaurant that imports specialty ingredients directly from China.
facts.source_reference: Chows official site — https://chowsbd.com/ ; Chows LinkedIn — https://www.linkedin.com/company/chows
facts.evidence_note: 'Chows is a fine dining cantonese and dim sum restaurant in Dhaka. They source fresh local ingredients and specialty ingredients directly from China.'

facts.fact_text: Chows has been operating in Banani since at least 2015.
facts.evidence_note: 'Executive Chef CHOWS Chinese Restaurant, Banani, Dhaka / Mar 2015–Aug 2020.'

facts.fact_text: Ciao is led by chef Nayeem Ashraf, a judge of Shera Radhuni seasons 7 and 8 and founder of the SHINEE culinary schools; he named the restaurant after the Ciao Wine Bar where he worked in Canada.
facts.evidence_note: 'judge of Shera Radhuni Seasons 7 and 8, founder of SHINEE culinary schools ... During his time in Canada, he worked at an Italian restaurant called Ciao Wine Bar.'

facts.fact_text: Ciao shares its Banani dining room with Dessert Boutique by Nadia Lakhani - Italian food and desserts in one venue.
facts.evidence_note: 'Ciao and Dessert Boutique by Nadia Lakhani coexist in the same place, Road No 10A, Banani, allowing the consumers to have the best of both worlds in the same order.'

facts.fact_text: Ciao's menu is deliberately small - six pizzas and five pastas, with no starters or lasagna.
facts.evidence_note: 'The menu is refreshingly simple: six pizzas priced between Tk800 and Tk1800, and five pastas ranging from Tk650 to Tk950 ... no lasagna, no frills.'

facts.fact_text: Cielo Rooftop Banani occupies the 14th floor of AWR NIB Tower on Road 11.
facts.evidence_note: Listing address: '14th Floor, AWR NIB Tower, House 99, Block C, Road 11, Banani Model Town, Dhaka - 1213.'

facts.fact_text: The Cielo Rooftop brand previously operated at Paribag, Dhaka, before its current Gulshan and Banani rooftops.
facts.evidence_note: 'The beauty reveals at Cielo Rooftop Aquarium side..... at Paribag, Dhaka' (October 2020).

facts.fact_text: Cilantro and its sister restaurant Coentro take their names from the Spanish and Portuguese words for coriander; Coentro opened as Cilantro's second branch.
facts.evidence_note: 'Coentro is basically the second branch of Cilantro. Both words mean coriander: 'coentro' is a Portuguese word while its older counterpart is Spanish.'

facts.fact_text: Cilantro's interior is known for exposed brick, glass bottles and a central skylight, with low tables where diners sit cross-legged after removing shoes.
facts.evidence_note: 'The interior is an eclectic affair of exposed brick, glass bottles and a central skylight ... a few lower tables, where you can take off your shoes and sit cross-legged.'

facts.fact_text: Coal & Coffee is a local Dhaka coffee-and-food chain, but its Banani branch menu is built around kebabs, rice, breads and curries rather than coffee drinks - delivery platforms list the brand under the 'Kebab' category.
facts.evidence_note: foodpanda's Mohakhali Coal & Coffee page carries a 'Kebab' tag; the Banani branch menu categories (dataset) are Rice, Breads, Kebabs, Burgers, Curries, Combos with no beverage category, so despite the 'coffee shop' category it functions as a kebab/curry eatery.

facts.fact_text: Cricketer's Kitchen & Cafe was launched by former Bangladesh cricket captain Akram Khan, and its Gulshan premises are decorated around a cricket theme.
facts.evidence_note: BDCricTime headline: 'Akram Khan launches his own restaurant - Cricketers' Kitchen' (published 2018-11-08); Wanderlog review describes 'a cricket-themed dining experience' where 'cricket is all around you.'

facts.fact_text: The restaurant has outdoor dining space adjacent to the lake (Hatirjheel/Gulshan lake area), adding a waterside element to the cricket-themed venue.
facts.evidence_note: Wanderlog: 'There is also an open space with tables laid out, and which is adjacent to a lake. This adds an extra flavour to the overall ambience.'

facts.restaurant_name: Crowne Plaza Dhaka Gulshan Crowne Plaza Dhaka Gulshan
facts.fact_text: The hotel's all-day dining buffet, The Flair, sits on the 24th floor of Crowne Plaza Dhaka Gulshan and overlooks the Dhaka skyline; the property launched the Crowne Plaza brand in Bangladesh in 2023.
facts.source_reference: IHG Crowne Plaza Dhaka Gulshan (official) - https://www.ihg.com/crowneplaza/hotels/us/en/dhaka/daccr/hoteldetail/dining; IHG Newsroom (2023)
facts.evidence_note: IHG official: 'The Flair... Situated on the 24th floor... provides a captivating view of the city skyline'; IHG press release titled 'Crowne Plaza Hotels & Resorts launches in Bangladesh' (2023).

facts.fact_text: Dhaba has served Indian street food in Banani since at least 2010, when it operated on Road 11; it later moved to its current Road 13/C location.
facts.source_reference: Ishy's Eats blog (2010) - http://ishyseats.blogspot.com/2010/; Wanderlog (Dhaba Banani)
facts.evidence_note: The 2010 blog lists 'Dhaba-1, House 100, Rd 11, Block C, Banani' serving dahi fuchka and dahi vada; a Wanderlog review recalls the eatery 'when it was located on Street 11' before it 'migrated to a new location.'

facts.fact_text: Known for street-style phuchka and chaat in a casual 'adda' (gathering) setting.
facts.evidence_note: Reserveit: "our popular phuchka and chaat that you can enjoy with friends and family during a fun adda."

facts.fact_text: DUNE is a recently opened restaurant in Banani (opened 2026) whose own promotional copy and branding follow a desert/dune theme - 'beyond the caves, beyond the sand.'
facts.source_reference: DUNE DHAKA Facebook page (2026) - https://www.facebook.com/dunedhaka/; co-owner Md Zahid on LinkedIn (2026)
facts.evidence_note: FB post headline: 'Beyond the caves, beyond the sand, an experience begins... Dune finally arrives'; co-owner's LinkedIn post (May 2026) confirms the opening at House 27, Road 12/A, Block H, Banani.

facts.fact_text: The Banani branch - on the ground floor of Skylark Mark - is where dürüm started in 2020; the brand later expanded to other Dhaka neighbourhoods.
facts.evidence_note: The Daily Star: 'The first one is in Banani, Skylark Mark, which started in 2020.'

facts.fact_text: dürüm is a Turkish street-food concept built around doner wraps - 'dürüm' is the Turkish word for the wrap.
facts.evidence_note: The Daily Star: 'Durum is a street food joint that serves Turkish street food. The name... is inspired by dürüm which is a Turkish wrap that is filled with döner kebab.'

facts.fact_text: El Toro has operated as a steakhouse concept since the mid-1990s.
facts.evidence_note: Daily Star 2006: 'Established in 1994 El Toro... serves SONORAN-style Mexican food'; Dhaka Tribune 2022: 'The 1995 establishment witnessed three relocations, and is currently located at Gulshan 2 behind the Westin hotel.' (Founding year conflicts: 1994 vs 1995.)

facts.fact_text: El Toro's cooking follows the Sonora (northern Mexico) style, and its menu has long included a deep-fried ice cream dessert.
facts.evidence_note: Daily Star 2006: 'serves SONORAN-style Mexican food... El Toro is also famous for a unique dessert... Deep Fried Ice-Cream - the ice cream is covered in corn flake crumbs and then deep fried.'

facts.fact_text: Evviva describes itself as a Southern Italian ristorante, centering its menu on regional Southern Italian cooking (olive oil, seafood, tomato) rather than the butter-and-cream style of Northern Italy.
facts.evidence_note: Official site: 'We keep our passion and fascination in Southern Italian fare alive and well. Sun-grown ingredients like tomatoes, olives, citrus... embracing the sea with seafood and olive oil instead of the butter and cream found in the North.'

facts.fact_text: Evviva is chef-owned: chef Sera Monira Payal, who opened the restaurant in 2022, runs it as sole proprietor and head of the kitchen.
facts.evidence_note: LinkedIn profile: 'Chef-Owner - Evviva Italian Ristorante, Nov 2022 - Present... She is the sole proprietor and the face of the brand on all media platforms.'

facts.fact_text: Fakhruddin Biriyani grew out of a school canteen: founder Fakruddin Munshi started by running the kitchen at Viqarunnisa Noon School & College in Dhaka after training under a chef for the Nawabs of Murshidabad; his sons continue serving his kachchi biryani recipe.
facts.source_reference: Dhaka Tribune (2021) - https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/dhaka/236848/; Fakruddin official company profile (fakruddin.com)
facts.evidence_note: Dhaka Tribune: 'Starting from a school kitchen of 200 sq feet... founder of Fakruddin Biriyani Late Fakruddin Munshi turned it into a full-fledged business... He died back in 1997 but his sons are still serving his recipe'; official profile: 'young FAKRUDDIN Munshi was picked for apprenticeship under Muslim Miah, a chef for the Nawabs of Murshidabad.'

facts.fact_text: Fish & Co. is a Singapore-founded seafood chain known for serving seafood in a pan.
facts.source_reference: Fish & Co. Restaurants Pte Ltd company profile; Jewel Changi Airport official listing (fish-co.com)
facts.evidence_note: 'Established in 1998, Fish & Co. is a casual, family-friendly restaurant serving fresh seafood in a pan... Inspired by Mediterranean fishermen who cooked their catch straight from the sea.'

facts.fact_text: Flambe has operated as a continental steak restaurant in Gulshan since at least 2004, when The Daily Star described it as sitting opposite Gulshan Club with a lake-view dining corner.
facts.evidence_note: 2004 review: 'The restaurant at Gulshan... Located just opposite the Gulshan Club, sitting in the Lake View corner of Flambé... sizzling steak and mouth-watering continental cuisine.' Later references (chef profiles 2014, LinkedIn 2018) place it in Gulshan-2, corroborating longevity.

facts.fact_text: Food Engineering is named for its founders' engineering background: it was founded in 2018 by electrical engineer Md. Faisal Al Islam, and the brand's own materials describe it as 'an establishment by engineers.'
facts.source_reference: Founder Md. Faisal Al Islam LinkedIn (2026); Food Engineering brand page (sites.google.com)
facts.evidence_note: Founder's LinkedIn: 'Owner - Food Engineering, Jan 2018 - Present... B.Sc. in Electrical & Electronics Engineering'; brand page: 'An Establishment by Engineers, who believe in quality more than quantity.'

facts.fact_text: Fool's Diner is a small Banani diner that brought sushi to a lower price point in Dhaka, where sushi had previously been limited to upscale Japanese restaurants.
facts.evidence_note: The Daily Star: 'Sushi has always been a high-end food item only available in the most exclusive of Japanese restaurants of Dhaka. Fool's Diner is here to change that.'

facts.fact_text: Fool's Diner is part of the Emerald Restaurant group, which also operates Thai Emerald, Red Chamber, Kiyoshi and other Dhaka outlets.
facts.evidence_note: 'Emerald Group of Restaurants began its journey with Thai Emerald... we proudly introduced... Fools Diner, Red Chamber, Kiyoshi, Grove Bistro, Gusto, Trouvaille, and Emerald Bakery.'

facts.fact_text: G.O.A.T stands for 'Gourmet, Otto, Artisan and Tales' - a Banani restaurant whose menu mixes Turkish classics with lesser-known Middle Eastern dishes.
facts.evidence_note: TBS: 'G.O.A.T - short for Gourmet Otto Artisan and Tales'; Dhaka Tribune: 'Turkish fusion food with... pides, doners, and kebab platters, while also incorporating lesser-known Middle Eastern dishes in a cozy café setting.'

facts.fact_text: G.O.A.T's Banani space is small and fills up on weekends and peak hours, so booking ahead is advised.
facts.evidence_note: TBS: 'due to the small seating capacity and the restaurant getting very crowded, especially during weekends and different peak hours, it's best to book a reservation in advance.'

facts.fact_text: Galito's is a South African flame-grilled piri-piri chicken franchise; its Gulshan-2 outlet, opened in January 2023, was the brand's first in Bangladesh.
facts.source_reference: Galito's International (2023) - https://www.galitos.com/blog/2023/02/23/; The Daily Observer
facts.evidence_note: Galito's blog: 'officially launched its maiden outlet in Bangladesh on 22 January 2023'; Observer: 'brought the international food chain Gallito's from South Africa, the land of Piri-Piri.'

facts.fact_text: Garlic 'n Ginger is operated by SR Group, a Dhaka-based hospitality company whose restaurant portfolio also includes The Great Kebab Factory, Food Village and Sung Garden.
facts.evidence_note: 'Garlic 'N' Ginger, The Great Kebab Factory, Food Village, Food Village Plus, and Sung Food Garden are few of the top fine dine restaurants... which are owned by SR Group.'

facts.fact_text: Ginza's Banani outlet, which opened in 2017, is the brand's original location (a Dhanmondi branch followed in mid-2023).
facts.evidence_note: 'After establishing a presence in Banani in 2017, Ginza expanded to Dhanmoni a little over five months ago in June 2023.'

facts.fact_text: Ginza serves Japanese fusion food, deliberately adjusting Japanese flavours to appeal to Bangladeshi tastes.
facts.evidence_note: 'They opted for Japanese fusion cuisine since they knew they would need to make some minor adjustments to the flavours so that they would appeal to the majority of Bangladeshis.'

facts.fact_text: Goong (Korean for 'palace') was previously named Dae Jang Geum; it changed its name after another Dae Jang Geum opened on the same street, and has served Korean palace-style cuisine in Gulshan for more than a decade.
facts.evidence_note: 'Goong, the Castle... Previously called Dae Jang Geum until another restaurant named Dae Jang Geum moved in on the same street... Korean palace food.'

facts.fact_text: Grand Buffet sits on the 13th floor of ANZ Square in Banani with glass-walled city views; its dinner buffet spans about 101 items, with live dosa and kebab stations and unlimited soft drinks and tea/coffee.
facts.source_reference: The Bangladesh Monitor (hotel & restaurant trade publication)
facts.evidence_note: 'The glass walls around provide you with a mesmerizing city view from the 13th floor... at dinner the restaurant offers 101 items... dosas and kebabs are cooked right in front of the guests... unlimited complimentary soft drinks... tea and coffee as well.'

facts.fact_text: Grandiose is the all-day multi-cuisine buffet restaurant of Dhaka Regency Hotel & Resort (Level 6); the hotel itself sits on Airport Road in Nikunja-2, near the airport rather than inside the Banani/Gulshan cluster where it appears in listings.
facts.evidence_note: Official: 'Location: Level: 6... Dhaka Regency Hotel & Resort Ltd. Airport Road, Nikunja 2 Dhaka 1229.'

facts.fact_text: Great Britain Fish N Chips opened in early 2023 as a very small eatery (about 7-8 seats) opposite Banani Supermarket.
facts.evidence_note: 'Great Britain Fish N Chips started its journey in early 2023. The restaurant is quite small, accommodating only seven to eight people... opposite Banani Supermarket.'

facts.fact_text: Its fish-and-chips and other seafood dishes are priced under Tk300, well below the Tk500-600 a plate of fish and chips typically costs at Dhaka restaurants.
facts.evidence_note: 'A plate of fish and chips typically costs at least Tk500 to Tk600 at most restaurants... they offer a wide range of seafood dishes, all priced under Tk300.'

facts.fact_text: Green & Pepper is a homegrown Bangladeshi peri-peri chicken brand, built on its own recipe as a local alternative to international peri-peri chains.
facts.evidence_note: 'a local Bangladeshi restaurant, has aimed to recreate the same flavour for Dhakaites with a local touch... recreating [the] signature taste with [a] unique recipe.'

facts.fact_text: Its Gulshan-2 branch (House 19, Road 95) opened in December 2023 as the brand's second outlet, after its first in Bashundhara.
facts.evidence_note: Company LinkedIn (Dec 2023): 'Green & Pepper Restaurant Limited has just opened its 2nd branch at Gulshan 2, House 19, Road 95.'

facts.fact_text: HAKKA DHAKA specializes in Hakka Chinese cuisine - the cooking tradition of the Hakka people - fused with local ingredients; Google Maps lists it under the broader 'Cantonese' category.
facts.source_reference: HAKKA DHAKA official site (hakkadhaka.page); company LinkedIn
facts.evidence_note: Official site: 'Hakka Dhaka opened its doors in 2014... We fuse authentic Hakka cuisine with local ingredients and cooking techniques.'

facts.fact_text: Hakka Dhaka opened in 2014.
facts.source_reference: HAKKA DHAKA official site (hakkadhaka.page); company LinkedIn
facts.evidence_note: Official site: 'Hakka Dhaka opened its doors in 2014'; LinkedIn company page: 'founded in 2014.'

facts.fact_text: Halda Valley Tea Lounge is owned by Halda Valley Food & Beverage Ltd, the company behind the Halda Valley Tea Garden in Fatikchhari, Chattogram - a roughly 500-hectare estate established in 2003 - making the Gulshan lounge the tea estate's urban outlet.
facts.source_reference: Halda Valley Tea Lounge official (tealounge.haldavalley.com); Letmibd company profile; RTC Architects
facts.evidence_note: Letmibd: 'Halda Valley Tea Garden is one of the best Tea estates of Bangladesh, located at Narayanhat, Fatikchhari... around 500 Hecters of Land since its inception on 2003.'

facts.fact_text: The lounge serves around 30 varieties of tea, with loose leaves brewed in full view of guests.
facts.evidence_note: 'People who love tea can have an authentic experience of conventional, as well as 30 different varieties of tea, served here. The customers can see tea leaves in the pots used.'

facts.fact_text: Opened in October 2019, described by sources as the first tea lounge in Bangladesh.
facts.evidence_note: TBS (2025): "there had been no specialised high-end tea shop ... Halda Valley opened a dedicated tea lounge in Gulshan, Dhaka, in October 2019"; TripAdvisor: "First Tea lounge in Bangladesh."

facts.fact_text: Handi started in Chittagong and later expanded to Dhaka, adding branches in Gulshan and Dhanmondi.
facts.evidence_note: Petit Futé describes Handi as having its mother restaurant in Chittagong with branches in Dhanmondi and Gulshan before opening in Cox's Bazar.

facts.fact_text: During Ramadan, Handi runs sehri service into the early morning, a practice its staff said had been running for about four years as of 2018.
facts.evidence_note: Handi entrepreneur Md Mohiuddin Al Riyad Bappy said 'several hundred people rush to the restaurant from nearby areas for sehri' and cited 'four years of experience in continuing with sehri arrangement.'

facts.fact_text: Haze operates primarily as a shisha lounge with a limited food menu, rather than a traditional restaurant.
facts.evidence_note: A Wanderlog reviewer states 'It is actually a Hokkah Bar (Sisha Lounge), they don't serve food' and another notes 'you must be over 21 to go to this lounge.'

facts.fact_text: Hello Dhaka, despite its English name, is a deshi-food specialist whose menu is built around Bangladeshi items such as khichuri platters, bhorta bhaji and coconut chingri.
facts.evidence_note: Listing describes Hello Dhaka as serving 'traditional Bangladeshi favorites, including the highly praised Khichuri platter'; review highlights mention Bhorta Bhaji and Coconut Chingri.

facts.fact_text: Hello Dhaka began late-night delivery after pandemic-era disruption to its hours and still serves until around 1am.
facts.evidence_note: Director Esha Rushdi said 'the disrupted hours of operations during the pandemic prompted them to begin late-night deliveries.'

facts.fact_text: Herfy is a Saudi fast-food chain founded in Riyadh in 1981 by Ahmed Hamad Al-Saeed; the Banani outlet is part of this Saudi-origin brand.
facts.evidence_note: NRN: 'Since its founding in 1981 by Ahmed Hamad Al Saeed... the now-194-unit Riyadh-based Herfy chain.' Herfy's own site: 'Herfy embarked on its journey in 1981.'

facts.fact_text: Herfy opened its first Bangladesh branch — and its first outside the Middle East — in Gulshan, Dhaka, on 22 December 2017.
facts.evidence_note: 'Herfy opened its first branch outside the Middle East in Bangladesh in December 22, 2017... The first branch opened in Gulshan, Dhaka, Bangladesh.'

facts.fact_text: Hungry Rooster is a fried-chicken brand operated by Devour, a Dhaka cloud-kitchen company that also runs Pimentos, Jhotpot and Pizzamia; the Banani outlet sits within Devour's 'The HIVE' facility.
facts.source_reference: Devour official site — https://www.devourworld.com/; Devour LinkedIn (2020)
facts.evidence_note: 'Devour has a total of four brands under its name: Hungry Rooster, Pimentos, Jhotpot, and Pizzamia... Hungry Rooster specializes in Fried Chicken.' Bank partnership listing places the outlet at 'The HIVE, House:90, Road: 17A, Banani.'

facts.fact_text: Istanbul Restaurant has operated since 2012 and is run with Turkish chef Ali Gunes serving as chef and part-owner.
facts.evidence_note: 'Chef Ali Gunes, who has served as both chef and part owner since 2012... Having been in operation since 2012.'

facts.fact_text: Izakaya launched in 2018 as a Japanese izakaya (pub-style) concept under the Bangladeshi conglomerate Dekko Isho Group.
facts.source_reference: Dekko ISHO Group official — https://dekkoisho.com/buisnesses/izakaya/; The Business Standard (2023) — https://www.tbsnews.net/economy/corporates/izakayas-new-restaurant-uttara-offers-japanese-cuisine-608090
facts.evidence_note: 'Izakaya was established in 2018, as a concern of Bangladeshi conglomerate, Dekko Isho Group.' TBS: 'Izakaya was launched in 2018 with a vision to introduce a curated selection of Japanese-fusion flavours.'

facts.fact_text: In October 2025 Izakaya ran what it described as Bangladesh's first drone food-delivery trial from its Gulshan 2 outlet, dropping meals onto rooftops in the Gulshan-Banani radius.
facts.evidence_note: 'Izakaya conducted Bangladesh's first drone-based food delivery trial from its Gulshan 2 outlet, targeting rooftops within the Gulshan-Banani radius.'

facts.fact_text: Izakaya has intentionally stayed off major food-delivery platforms, handling its own delivery instead.
facts.evidence_note: 'Izakaya... has intentionally stayed off major food delivery platforms, choosing instead to build more control over its delivery system.'

facts.restaurant_name: Japanese Restaurant ICHI in Banani, Dhaka.
facts.fact_text: ICHI in Banani has a Japanese proprietress on site and staff who use some Japanese, an unusual feature for a Dhaka restaurant.
facts.evidence_note: A Japanese traveler's review notes 'a Japanese proprietress is resident, so you can feel at ease' and 'some staff also use Japanese.'

facts.fact_text: Jatra Biroti is the rooftop restaurant of Jatra, a craft and clothing house founded in 2000 by artist and musician Anusheh Anadil; it runs a fully vegetarian kitchen.
facts.source_reference: Jatra Biroti official (our story) — https://www.jatrabiroti.com/our-story; Dhaka Tribune (2025) — https://www.dhakatribune.com/business/376452/jatra-biroti-joyous-celebration-of-all-things
facts.evidence_note: Official site: 'Jatra was created in year 2000 by artist and musician Anusheh Anadil.' Dhaka Tribune: 'This vegetarian establishment caters to a diverse customer base' and the restaurant serves as a 'biroti' (break) from shopping at the Jatra store.

facts.fact_text: The restaurant sits on a rooftop whose red floor and white alpona are designed to evoke a traditional Bengali uthaan (courtyard).
facts.evidence_note: 'One of the most iconic features is Jatra Biroti with its red floor and the white alpona on it... creates the imagery of the classic Bangali uthaan or courtyard.'

facts.fact_text: Jatra Biroti runs plastic-free operations, using cloth napkins and serving free drinking water as part of its sustainability practices.
facts.evidence_note: 'They use cloth napkins instead of paper ones, prohibit plastic items, and offer free water to support environmentally friendly practices.'

facts.fact_text: Kacchi Bhai's name fuses 'kacchi' with 'bhai' (brother); the chain's first outlet opened at Basundhara Gate, reportedly without air conditioning due to unreliable power.
facts.evidence_note: Founder Shoel Shiraj: the first branch opened at Bashundhara Gate; there was not enough electricity, so it ran without AC — 'প্রথম ব্রাঞ্চ এসি ছাড়া খুলা হয়েছিল.'

facts.fact_text: Kebabzz opened in Banani in 2024; co-owner Hasan Reza said he launched it to bring the Mirpur-style kebab taste to Banani diners.
facts.evidence_note: 'I have seen people travel from Gulshan and Banani to Mirpur, so I wanted to bring the taste of Mirpur to Banani,' said co-owner Hasan Reza. The article notes Kebabzz 'launched a couple of months ago.'

facts.fact_text: KFD Express is a dumpling-focused Chinese fast-food chain that grew out of a 'Kung Fu Dumplings' brand identity (its Facebook page runs as 'KFD Kung Fu Dumplings').
facts.source_reference: Prothom Alo English (2025) — https://en.prothomalo.com/lifestyle/w2ql641ket; KFD Express Facebook — https://www.facebook.com/KFDKungfuDumplings
facts.evidence_note: Prothom Alo: 'KFD Express – A paradise for dumpling lovers, offering a variety of handmade Chinese dumplings alongside classic Chinese favorites.' Facebook handle: KFDKungfuDumplings.

facts.fact_text: Khana's began as a food cart and was rebranded from 'Ande Khana' when it moved into the Kazi Food Island food court near Bashundhara, pricing its menu around nearby university students.
facts.evidence_note: '[It] started its journey from a food cart... rebranding their restaurant as Khana's... Initially, Khana's Bashundhara targeted students of private universities in nearby areas and set their prices accordingly.'

facts.fact_text: Khao San was launched by the same group that runs the fast-food chain Munch Station.
facts.evidence_note: 'The Khao San in Dhaka, however, is a food dream of the same group that started Munch Station — Syed Sameem Shahriyar, Taposh Ghosh, Mustafid Raiyan Khan and Bushra Haque Sarah.'

facts.fact_text: KHAZANA opened in Gulshan 2 in the early 2000s as a franchise of Indian celebrity chef Sanjeev Kapoor's 'Khazana' brand.
facts.source_reference: The Daily Star Star Magazine (2004) — https://archive.thedailystar.net/magazine/2004/03/02/venture.htm; Dhaka Tribune (2022) — https://www.dhakatribune.com/business/277193/20-years-later-khazana-is-still-the-best-indian
facts.evidence_note: 2004 Star Magazine: 'Sanjeev Kapoor's Khazana in Gulshan 2 came into being.' Dhaka Tribune (2022) confirms roughly 20 years of operation for the same brand.

facts.fact_text: Khazana operates a sweets shop called Khazana Mithai alongside the restaurant.
facts.evidence_note: Daily Star (2017): 'The new and improved Khazana includes the restaurant, Khazana mithai as well as two large banquet halls.'

facts.fact_text: A restaurant named Khushboo has been present in the Gulshan 1 area since at least 2003, when The Daily Star covered its Ramadan iftar packages at Road 132 (the current outlet is listed at Road 131).
facts.evidence_note: Daily Star (2003): 'Khushboo, located at House 53/B, Road 132, Gulshan 1, offers three special iftar packages for the holy month.' The current Khushboo Restaurant is listed at House 60/B, Road 131, Gulshan 1.

facts.fact_text: Kiva Han takes its name from the Turkish word for 'coffee house' — the name of the world's first coffee house, which opened in Istanbul in the 16th century.
facts.source_reference: Kiva Han official (kivahancafe.com) — https://kivahancafe.com/about/; The Daily Star (2020) — https://www.thedailystar.net/business/news/inside-look-kiva-han-1992529
facts.evidence_note: Official site: 'Named after the first coffee house founded back in Istanbul, Turkey around 16th Century.' Founder interview: 'Kiva Han is a Turkish word that means Coffee House, and it was also the name of the first coffee shop in the world.'

facts.fact_text: Kiva Han opened its first outlet in Gulshan-1 in April 2013; its founder, an architect who returned from England, had conceived the coffee-house plan in 2007.
facts.evidence_note: 'I wanted to open Kiva Han in 2007, but had to wait until April of 2013... My father helped me out at launching my first outlet in Gulshan-1.'

facts.fact_text: Koreana has been serving Korean food in Gulshan 1 since at least 2006, when The Daily Star profiled its menu.
facts.source_reference: The Daily Star archive (2006) — https://archive.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/2006/11/02/page04.htm; The Daily Star (2014) — https://www.thedailystar.net/korean-food-festival-held-at-gulshan-club-13759
facts.evidence_note: 2006 Star Weekend listing: 'Koreana (Hs 5, Rd 136, Gulshan 1...)' with a review of its Korean menu. A 2014 article confirms Koreana took part in the 'Taste of Korea' festival.

facts.fact_text: Koyla in Banani serves sheermal, a mildly sweet saffron-infused naan from the Mughal era, which must be ordered in advance rather than on the spot.
facts.evidence_note: The Star's Shab-e-Barat feature says "sheermal naan from Koyla in Banani... you have to order them beforehand", priced at Tk 135.

facts.fact_text: Laam is one of the few Spanish restaurants in Dhaka, located in Gulshan-2, and is listed in the Foods and Wines from Spain certified-restaurant directory, with a menu centered on tapas, paella and Spanish seafood.
facts.source_reference: Foods and Wines from Spain (Spanish government initiative) — https://www.foodswinesfromspain.com/en/certified-restaurants-from-spain/restaurants/l/laam
facts.evidence_note: Directory lists 'Laam' as 'Spanish Cuisine, Tapas' in Gulshan-2, Dhaka, offering 'tapas, paella, or fresh seafood from Spain.'

facts.fact_text: Lahore by IKitchen grew out of IKitchen, a cloud kitchen launched in October 2020 during the pandemic; its Banani dining outlet was opened as a response to demand for the cloud kitchen's Lahori dishes.
facts.evidence_note: Tribune: IKitchen was 'one of those cloud kitchens born during the pandemic' and the restaurant is 'a gesture of gratitude to the people who developed a taste for Lahori food.' Star: IKitchen 'began their journey on October 2020.'

facts.fact_text: The restaurant deliberately serves only Lahori (Pakistani) cuisine rather than adapting its menu to Indian or Bengali tastes.
facts.evidence_note: Founder Romi F Ahsan: "we're sure to provide just Lahori food, not Indian or Bengali."

facts.fact_text: Lakeshore Suites is part of Lakeshore Hotels, a Dhaka hotel group operating since 2004 that traces its origins to the founder's earlier motel, Golden Goose.
facts.evidence_note: Official site: 'Since 2004... Lakeshore stands as the oldest privately-owned hotel business in Dhaka'; 'What began with a modest motel named Golden Goose has grown into one of Bangladesh's most respected hospitality brands.'

facts.fact_text: Laughing Buddha, opened in Gulshan in early 2020, focuses on northern Thai cuisine and has been led by Thai chefs from Chiang Mai.
facts.evidence_note: Showcase: 'authentic Thai cuisine experience in Dhaka made by their very own Thai chefs, making their way long from Changmai, Thailand.' Tinds: the restaurant 'opened its doors in early 2020.'

facts.fact_text: Laughing Buddha holds Thai Select Signature certification, a Thai government accreditation for authentic Thai restaurants abroad.
facts.evidence_note: Bangladesh Monitor: 'Thai Select Signature is the highest level of accreditation, given to restaurants that exceed all of the criteria'; the certificate ceremony was held at the Gulshan outlet. UNB lists Laughing Buddha among currently operating Thai Select certified restaurants.

facts.fact_text: Lucknow built its menu around Awadhi (Lucknowi) cuisine at a time when, its management says, that style was rarely served in Dhaka's Indian restaurants; it has included unusual variants such as a biryani served with spinach and a keema biryani.
facts.evidence_note: In a 2016 interview, its director Zeenat said 'Awadhi cuisine has not been explored at length. This is what gives us our edge' and cited the spinach biryani and keema biryani as dishes 'not served in other Indian restaurants.'

facts.fact_text: Madchef & Cheez grew from a single food cart into a brand with 16 outlets within eight years; this Gulshan-1 location operates as one of the brand's cloud-kitchen (delivery-focused) outlets.
facts.evidence_note: The Star: 'going from one cart to 16 outlets within eight years.' The Tribune describes Cheez being launched when Madchef moved from its Banani Road 17/A outlet; the outlet's own name and delivery focus identify it as a cloud kitchen.

facts.fact_text: Runs its kitchen centrally: every dish is prepared from ready-to-cook formulas made in a central kitchen in Badda, so no branch outlet has its own designated chef
facts.evidence_note: 'Utshob does not have a designated chef in any branch. All of their dishes come in formulas... made in its central kitchen in Saatarkul, Badda'

facts.fact_text: Serves a contemporary Asian menu crafted by Michelin Guide-recognized Thai chef Nan Thaisuchat
facts.evidence_note: 'Vault presents a contemporary Asian menu crafted by Michelin Guide-recognized Chef Nan Thaisuchat from Thailand'

facts.fact_text: Located in the basement of Autograph Tower, Banani, with live music featuring resident DJs, percussionists, singers and flautists
facts.evidence_note: 'The restaurant is located in the basement of the Autograph Tower in Banani'; 'live music with resident DJs, percussionists, singers, and flautists'

facts.fact_text: Signature 'Ilish Lollipop' is a modern spin on the traditional ilish fish
facts.evidence_note: 'Take our Ilish Lollipop, for example. It is a modern spin on the beloved Ilish'

facts.fact_text: Hare Krishna-run cafe beside the Vatara Kali Mondir temple that advertises 100% vegetarian food, with most of the menu vegan
facts.evidence_note: HappyCow: 'Hare Krishna cafe that advertises itself as 100% vegetarian, yet most of the food is vegan'; located at Vatara Kali Mondir

facts.fact_text: Has a small, rotating menu that changes daily with only a few tables - a temple-adjacent, home-cooking style set-up
facts.evidence_note: HappyCow: 'Has a limited menu that varies by day. Has 3 tables.'

facts.fact_text: Launched in 2021 as a Bangladeshi waffle start-up and has since grown into a global QSR franchise with outlets across Bangladesh, Singapore, Indonesia, Dubai and Thailand
facts.evidence_note: Official site: 'first baked in Bangladesh and is currently the largest and fastest growing QSR waffle chain'; Dhaka Tribune: opening branches in Singapore, Thailand, Dubai, Indonesia

facts.fact_text: Claims to be the first brand in Bangladesh to serve waffles on a stick
facts.evidence_note: Dhaka Tribune (2025): "As the first ones to serve waffles on a stick in Bangladesh"; official site markets "Waffle On A Stick" as the core format.

facts.fact_text: One of Dhaka's few restaurants dedicated to Kashmiri and Awadhi cuisine, operating from a rooftop spot in Banani
facts.evidence_note: Review describes Waza as serving Kashmiri and Awadhi food in Banani; rooftop setting confirmed in review coverage

facts.fact_text: Texas-style grill house open in Banani since 2017, known for slow-cooked brisket and Austin-style ribs
facts.evidence_note: Bangladesh Post: 'favourite among all since it opened in 2017'; Dhaka Tribune reviews slow-cooked brisket and ribs

facts.fact_text: Relies mostly on imported meat for its steaks - a supply line that became a challenge under Bangladesh's import restrictions
facts.evidence_note: Manager Leon Stiphen Gomes: 'The steaks were normally imported and imports are restricted by the government, so that's been difficult'

facts.fact_text: Stays open until 3 AM, from 4:30 PM.
facts.evidence_note: DhakaEats hours: Sunday 4:30 pm – 3:00 am (all days).

facts.fact_text: Founded in 2017 as 'a modern take on Chinese tea houses', built around a wide dim sum menu plus a full Asian fusion line
facts.evidence_note: Official site: 'EST. | 2017'; 'A modern take on Chinese tea houses... a full-course, Asian fusion menu'

facts.fact_text: The Gulshan branch (60A, Road 131) is the brand's newer outlet; the original is in Dhanmondi, and the brand calls itself 'The Pan-Asian Love Affair'
facts.evidence_note: Official site lists Gulshan and Dhanmondi locations; Facebook intro: 'The Pan-Asian Love Affair'

facts.fact_text: Opened in March 2022 on level 27 - the top floor of Sheraton Dhaka and the highest point in Banani - with panoramic views over the city
facts.evidence_note: 'Located on level 27, at the top of the 5-star hotel and the highest point in Banani'

facts.fact_text: Dinner-only Japanese restaurant (6:30pm-11pm) that serves nightly Teppanyaki, a format no other five-star hotel in Dhaka offers
facts.evidence_note: 'open every day for dinner from 6:30pm till 11pm'; 'It is a unique experience which is offered by no other five-star hotels in Dhaka'

facts.fact_text: Opened in September 2022 as a rooftop restaurant-lounge in Banani; the name means 'the gentle breeze' and the venue is styled as a rooftop garden with wall planters
facts.evidence_note: The Daily Star: 'opened its doors on September 2' with a rooftop view; ''Zephyr' represents the gentle breeze'; 'full of wall planters' with a green theme

facts.fact_text: Does not serve carbonated soft drinks - the menu offers only smoothies and fresh juices, with meals starting at Tk 450
facts.evidence_note: 'We do not serve carbonated soft drinks. Rather, a wide variety of refreshing smoothies and fresh juices are offered'; 'Meal prices start from Tk 450'
